citation: MIP-4, section 6: the doorbell rings only an empty prompt. The 2.1.283 screens are corpus/conformance/agent-detection-recorded.json's, recorded from Claude Code 2.1.283; the 2.1.288 screens of an agent at work were recorded the same way, by tools/detection-capture.py, with the capture's folder renamed /tmp/capture, as were Codex 0.154.0's; how it draws a suggestion nobody typed, every cell faint, is held to the installed Claude Code by claude_code_doorbell's live check.
why: The doorbell types into a pane only when its agent's screen reads as that agent at an empty prompt. Each case is a screen as drawn, its title and progress, and the same screen as typed - every faint cell blank - and says whether the rule deciding the screen shows the prompt, and what the prompt holds. A case with no `typed` reads the screen as typed whole.

cases.name: claude 2.1.283: a new prompt showing a suggestion is empty
cases.why: The suggestion is drawn faint, so in the typed view it is blank: nobody typed it, and a ring typed here would be sent alone.

cases.name: claude 2.1.283: the same prompt with the words typed holds them
cases.why: The same text, typed rather than suggested, is a person's draft: a ring would be sent inside it, so the prompt holds it and the doorbell waits.

expect.holds: Try "how do I log an error?"
